why:
A1 [Y]: A dataset-specific stable repository/deposit and the assessed release are identified; this is inventory identity, not verified retrieval.

A2 [Y]: The saved evidence describes the release access/download or request route; registration/restrictions do not reduce credit.

A3 [U]: Release-specific data terms are not established; code-license tags, missing terms and unspecified licenses are insufficient.

L1 [Y]: The saved source describes the available targets and their meaning for this released task; no quality premium is assigned to boxes or masks.

L2 [Y]: Target encoding and a basic manual/measurement/derived-label procedure are jointly described; detailed annotator manuals are not required.

L4 [U]: No concrete target-review/correction/verification practice is established; multiple annotators, publication, file availability or generic quality claims alone do not qualify.

D1 [U]: File meanings, relevant units/missing codes or image-to-target mapping remain insufficiently documented.

D2 [Y]: The source summary identifies collection/compilation provenance and its method or named parent datasets.

D4 [Y]: Dataset-specific intended scope, selection exclusions or collection/annotation limitations are described in the source summary.

C1 [X]: The saved evidence explicitly leaves the 448 versus 369 image count release-dependent; no count selected by averaging.

C2 [Y]: The source reports quantitative class/outcome/subset accounting relevant to the documented task. It is not proof of statistical balance or independence.

R1 [Y]: Geography/site scope, pavement context and capture setting are jointly documented in the cited fields/source summary.

R2 [Y]: The source describes collection variation or an explicit restricted scope; breadth itself earns no bonus.

M1 [Y]: A useful collection platform, sensor or generation/derivation method is identified.

M2 [Y]: Task-relevant image resolution or signal/measurement representation is explicitly reported; image pixels are not physical crack-width accuracy.

M5 [Y]: Preprocessing, cropping, resizing, filtering, fusion or explicit absence of augmentation is documented.
